name: Chichu Art Museum (Benesse Art Site Naoshima)
intro: An art museum on the island of Naoshima, built mostly underground, where a few works are shown in natural light. Entry is by timed ticket only, and a whole month goes on sale at once.

facts.bookAhead: Two months: tickets go on sale on the 5th, for the month after next

statusNote: Read from the official Benesse Art Site Naoshima FAQ.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: a must-see for art lovers, but Naoshima is far off the usual route.
difficultyNote: Reasoning: weekend and holiday slots in busy seasons sell out ahead; weekday slots often remain, and same-day tickets are sold if any are left (official).
bookingSteps: Check ferry times to Naoshima first. Museum tickets don't include buses or ferries.
Buy on the sales page of the official Benesse Art Site Naoshima website. Tickets aren't sold by phone.
At 10:00 Japan time on the 5th, choose a date and an entry time. Slots start every 15 minutes.
Add a ticket for every visitor. Ages 15 and under enter free but still need a reservation.
Pay by credit card: Visa, Mastercard or JCB. There is no fee for buying online.
Arrive on time. Your ticket is valid for 30 minutes from the reserved time.
visitorTips: Tickets can't be changed or cancelled. Refunds are given only if the museum closes, for example for bad weather.
Same-day tickets are sold if slots remain, until 30 minutes before the slot.
Junior and senior high school students should bring proof of student status.

faq.q: When do Chichu Art Museum tickets go on sale?
faq.a: At 10:00 Japan time on the 5th of each month, for the month after next. For example, tickets for October go on sale on August 5.

faq.q: How do I pay for Chichu Art Museum tickets?
faq.a: By credit card online: Visa, Mastercard or JCB.

sources.quote: We start selling online tickets for the month after next at 10:00 on the 5th of every month.
Ticket sales for October start at 10:00 on August 5th
Reservation tickets can be used for 30 minutes from the reservation time.
